title: Leading Open Meeting Law rulings, per issue
method: OURS, model-free. Ranked by how many later AG determinations cite each one; per issue: the two most cited, the most cited against a school committee, the newest, the other outcome if missing, then by citations. Decided on the merits only; each key passage re-checked verbatim against the letter. See scripts/build_oml_leading_rulings.py.
caution: A holding is the Attorney General’s reading of the law for ONE body on ONE set of facts. It is not a finding about any other board.
